Initially, there are 10 stalls with 20 cows each, so the total number of cows is $10 \times 20 = 200$. Mr. Sylas buys 40 cows and divides them equally among the 20 stalls, so each stall gets $40 \div 20 = 2$ additional cows. Therefore, each stall now has $20 + 2 = 22$ cows. The total number of cows in 8 of the stalls is $8 \times 22 = 176$.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 176
